semantic_axes.description: Mundane tasks are ordinary or dull regardless of status, while menial tasks involve low-skill, low-status work regardless of novelty.

edges.boundary_rule: Mundane tasks are ordinary or dull regardless of status, while menial tasks involve low-skill, low-status work regardless of novelty.

misconceptions.M3: Assuming challenging routine work is menial.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Ravi's daily duty?

beats.text: Ravi, the school’s head administrator, signs the usual attendance report every morning.
beats.reason: A senior official doing routine work is not necessarily doing low-status work.

beats.text: He uses a new blue pen today, but the report is the same standard paperwork.
beats.decisive_clue: pen choice does not alter status
beats.reason: Changing the pen leaves the report an ordinary daily task.

chains.feedback_short: Changing the pen leaves the report an ordinary daily task.
chains.feedback_deep: Mundane describes the everyday or unremarkable. Menial describes work that needs little skill and is treated as low-status; the two qualities may overlap but are not identical. Changing the pen leaves the report an ordinary daily task.
chains.contrast_rule: Mundane is ordinary; menial is low-status work.

hints.axis: Mundane tasks are ordinary or dull regardless of status, while menial tasks involve low-skill, low-status work regardless of novelty.
hints.contrast: Mundane is ordinary; menial is low-status work.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Amina's assigned work?

beats.text: Amina is asked to fold identical programmes before each performance.
She learns that this bottom-rank assignment needs no training and is always handed to the least senior helpers.
beats.decisive_clue: explicit low skill and lowest rank
beats.reason: The added low-skill, low-rank assignment makes status the defining feature.

beats.text: Jonas spends his shift carrying boxes on request, a task requiring almost no training and given only to the lowest-ranked temporary helpers.
beats.reason: The job description, not its sequence, establishes its status.

beats.text: A supervisor changes the order in which he carries them.
beats.reason: Changing the sequence leaves the same low-skill subordinate work.

She is simply sharing chores with her family, not serving anyone as a low-ranked worker.
beats.reason: Sharing household work does not make the activity a low-status assigned job.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Nina's packing job?

beats.text: Nina is hired only to put plain labels on parcels, with no training or responsibility for decisions.
beats.reason: The role, not the products, determines the label.

beats.text: Even when the parcels contain expensive products, she remains in the lowest-ranked packing role.
beats.decisive_clue: high product value does not raise task status
beats.reason: Expensive contents do not change the low-status, low-skill nature of her assignment.
